answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a stake for a full epoch, so spinning up thousands of hollow shells costs real capital instead of free registration. Reputation then grows like a vine: trust spreads only through verified work links between agents, so a fresh identity with no history cannot borrow standing. Attestations sit on a crystal-clear public ledger, letting anyone audit whether endorsements come from distinct stake-backed peers or from a cluster of self-created accounts.
